panels.title: Is it healing
panels.about: Every run in the order it started. The heal loop is where a red suite either dies or is given up on; these are the numbers it is judged by, and they have to move as the memory fills.

panels.title: Heal laps per run
panels.about: Every run in the order it started: heal laps over all its branches. The number the memory is judged by: it has to fall as lessons accumulate, or nothing is being learned. From the runner's own heal_lap events; runs from before the event are counted from heal phases.
queries: SELECT r.started AS time, 'heal laps' AS metric, coalesce(l.total, h.total, 0) AS value, r.name AS label FROM runs r LEFT JOIN (SELECT run, sum(laps) AS total, max(laps) AS most FROM (SELECT run, coalesce(json_extract(payload,'$.branch'),'') AS b, max(json_extract(payload,'$.lap')) AS laps FROM events WHERE kind='heal_lap' GROUP BY 1,2) GROUP BY run) l ON l.run=r.run LEFT JOIN (SELECT run, sum(n) AS total, max(n) AS most FROM (SELECT run, count(*) AS n FROM events WHERE kind='phase_end' AND json_extract(payload,'$.phase') LIKE '%heal%' GROUP BY run, coalesce(json_extract(payload,'$.branch'),'')) GROUP BY run) h ON h.run=r.run ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Heal laps on one branch, against the cap
panels.about: Per run, the most heal laps any one branch took, against the cap the runner gives up at - limits.heal_laps_per_branch, read from ammit at every decision. A bar at the line is a branch that spent its whole budget; over it is a run from before the cap was a limit.
queries: SELECT r.started AS time, 'most on one branch' AS metric, coalesce(l.most, h.most, 0) AS value, r.name AS label FROM runs r LEFT JOIN (SELECT run, sum(laps) AS total, max(laps) AS most FROM (SELECT run, coalesce(json_extract(payload,'$.branch'),'') AS b, max(json_extract(payload,'$.lap')) AS laps FROM events WHERE kind='heal_lap' GROUP BY 1,2) GROUP BY run) l ON l.run=r.run LEFT JOIN (SELECT run, sum(n) AS total, max(n) AS most FROM (SELECT run, count(*) AS n FROM events WHERE kind='phase_end' AND json_extract(payload,'$.phase') LIKE '%heal%' GROUP BY run, coalesce(json_extract(payload,'$.branch'),'')) GROUP BY run) h ON h.run=r.run ORDER BY 1

SELECT at AS time, name AS metric, value FROM limits WHERE name = 'limits.heal_laps_per_branch' AND at*1000 <= $__to AND (at*1000 >= $__from OR at = (SELECT max(at) FROM limits WHERE name = 'limits.heal_laps_per_branch' AND at*1000 < $__from)) ORDER BY at

panels.title: Heal laps after a suite with nothing failed
panels.about: Per run: heal laps that followed a suite reporting zero failed scenarios. The suite was red for another reason - the runner exiting non-zero, no scenario mapped - and the healer was sent to fix tests that passed. Run c306ccfe did this four times on one branch. From the suite events; older runs from the phase text.
queries: SELECT r.started AS time, 'laps on green' AS metric, coalesce(g.n,0) AS value, r.name AS label FROM runs r LEFT JOIN (SELECT run, count(*) AS n FROM (SELECT e.run, (SELECT s.failed FROM (SELECT at, run, coalesce(json_extract(payload,'$.branch'),'') AS branch, json_extract(payload,'$.verdict') AS verdict, json_extract(payload,'$.total') AS total, json_extract(payload,'$.passed') AS passed, json_extract(payload,'$.failed') AS failed, coalesce(json_extract(payload,'$.reason'),'') AS reason FROM events WHERE kind='suite' UNION ALL SELECT at, run, coalesce(json_extract(payload,'$.branch'),''), CASE WHEN instr(json_extract(payload,'$.text'),'SUITE GREEN')>0 THEN 'green' ELSE 'red' END, CAST(substr(substr(json_extract(payload,'$.text'), instr(json_extract(payload,'$.text'),'SUITE ')), instr(substr(json_extract(payload,'$.text'), instr(json_extract(payload,'$.text'),'SUITE ')),': ')+2) AS INTEGER), CAST(substr(json_extract(payload,'$.text'), instr(json_extract(payload,'$.text'),'scenarios, ')+11) AS INTEGER), CAST(substr(json_extract(payload,'$.text'), instr(json_extract(payload,'$.text'),'passed, ')+8) AS INTEGER), 'read from the phase text: before the suite event' FROM events WHERE kind='phase_end' AND json_extract(payload,'$.phase')='branchrun' AND run NOT IN (SELECT run FROM events WHERE kind='suite')) s WHERE s.run=e.run AND s.branch=coalesce(json_extract(e.payload,'$.branch'),'') AND s.at < e.at ORDER BY s.at DESC LIMIT 1) AS failed_before FROM events e WHERE e.kind='phase_start' AND json_extract(payload,'$.phase') LIKE '%heal%') WHERE failed_before = 0 GROUP BY run) g ON g.run=r.run ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Suite failures, first against last
panels.about: Per run, the failing scenarios summed over its branches at the first suite run and at the last, from the suite events. The distance between the two bars is what the heal loop bought; a last bar as tall as the first is a loop that ran and repaired nothing.
queries: SELECT r.started AS time, 'first suite' AS metric, coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN s.n=1 THEN s.failed END),0) AS value, r.name AS label FROM runs r LEFT JOIN (SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY run, branch ORDER BY at) AS n, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY run, branch ORDER BY at DESC) AS rn FROM (SELECT at, run, coalesce(json_extract(payload,'$.branch'),'') AS branch, json_extract(payload,'$.verdict') AS verdict, json_extract(payload,'$.total') AS total, json_extract(payload,'$.passed') AS passed, json_extract(payload,'$.failed') AS failed, coalesce(json_extract(payload,'$.reason'),'') AS reason FROM events WHERE kind='suite' UNION ALL SELECT at, run, coalesce(json_extract(payload,'$.branch'),''), CASE WHEN instr(json_extract(payload,'$.text'),'SUITE GREEN')>0 THEN 'green' ELSE 'red' END, CAST(substr(substr(json_extract(payload,'$.text'), instr(json_extract(payload,'$.text'),'SUITE ')), instr(substr(json_extract(payload,'$.text'), instr(json_extract(payload,'$.text'),'SUITE ')),': ')+2) AS INTEGER), CAST(substr(json_extract(payload,'$.text'), instr(json_extract(payload,'$.text'),'scenarios, ')+11) AS INTEGER), CAST(substr(json_extract(payload,'$.text'), instr(json_extract(payload,'$.text'),'passed, ')+8) AS INTEGER), 'read from the phase text: before the suite event' FROM events WHERE kind='phase_end' AND json_extract(payload,'$.phase')='branchrun' AND run NOT IN (SELECT run FROM events WHERE kind='suite'))) s ON s.run=r.run GROUP BY r.run UNION ALL SELECT r.started, 'last suite', coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN s.rn=1 THEN s.failed END),0), r.name FROM runs r LEFT JOIN (SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY run, branch ORDER BY at) AS n, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY run, branch ORDER BY at DESC) AS rn FROM (SELECT at, run, coalesce(json_extract(payload,'$.branch'),'') AS branch, json_extract(payload,'$.verdict') AS verdict, json_extract(payload,'$.total') AS total, json_extract(payload,'$.passed') AS passed, json_extract(payload,'$.failed') AS failed, coalesce(json_extract(payload,'$.reason'),'') AS reason FROM events WHERE kind='suite' UNION ALL SELECT at, run, coalesce(json_extract(payload,'$.branch'),''), CASE WHEN instr(json_extract(payload,'$.text'),'SUITE GREEN')>0 THEN 'green' ELSE 'red' END, CAST(substr(substr(json_extract(payload,'$.text'), instr(json_extract(payload,'$.text'),'SUITE ')), instr(substr(json_extract(payload,'$.text'), instr(json_extract(payload,'$.text'),'SUITE ')),': AND run NOT IN (SELECT run FROM events WHERE kind='suite'))) s ON s.run=r.run GROUP BY r.run ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Gate refusals per run
panels.about: How often a gate refused, per run. Falling with the lessons is learning; flat is a pipeline that reads its memory and does the same thing again.
queries: SELECT r.started AS time, 'red gates' AS metric, coalesce(g.reds,0) AS value, r.name AS label FROM runs r LEFT JOIN (SELECT run, sum(verdict='red') AS reds FROM gates GROUP BY run) g ON g.run=r.run ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Heal spend per run
panels.about: What the heal laps cost per run, in the sessions that reported a bill. A session ammit stopped part-way reports none, so this is a floor.
queries: SELECT r.started AS time, 'heal' AS metric, coalesce(m.usd,0) AS value, r.name AS label FROM runs r LEFT JOIN (SELECT run, round(sum(json_extract(payload,'$.usd')),2) AS usd FROM events WHERE kind='spend' AND json_extract(payload,'$.phase') LIKE '%heal%' GROUP BY run) m ON m.run=r.run ORDER BY 1

panels.title: What it learns from
panels.about: The memory the healer is handed: lessons stored after heal and revise phases, and injected into the next batch.

panels.title: Lessons in memory
panels.about: How many lessons the global memory held after each store or ingest. A line that does not climb while heal laps stay high is a memory nothing is being written to.
queries: SELECT at AS time, 'total' AS metric, json_extract(payload,'$.total') AS value FROM events WHERE kind='learning' AND json_extract(payload,'$.item')='lessons' ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Lessons per store
panels.about: Each time the memory was written to: how many lessons were new and how many confirmed one already there.
queries: SELECT at AS time, 'fresh' AS metric, json_extract(payload,'$.fresh') AS value FROM events WHERE kind='learning' AND json_extract(payload,'$.item')='lessons' UNION ALL SELECT at, 'confirmed', json_extract(payload,'$.confirmed') FROM events WHERE kind='learning' AND json_extract(payload,'$.item')='lessons' ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Memory stored and injected per run
panels.about: Per run: how many times the runner stored the run's case into the ticket's memory after a heal or revise phase, and how many times it injected past cases into a batch. Sessions do not ask the memory themselves; the runner asks for them.
queries: SELECT r.started AS time, 'stored' AS metric, coalesce(m.stored,0) AS value, r.name AS label FROM runs r LEFT JOIN (SELECT run, sum(json_extract(payload,'$.text') LIKE 'memory stored%') AS stored, sum(json_extract(payload,'$.text') LIKE 'memory injected%') AS injected FROM events WHERE kind='log' AND json_extract(payload,'$.text') LIKE 'memory %' GROUP BY run) m ON m.run=r.run UNION ALL SELECT r.started, 'injected', coalesce(m.injected,0), r.name FROM runs r LEFT JOIN (SELECT run, sum(json_extract(payload,'$.text') LIKE 'memory stored%') AS stored, sum(json_extract(payload,'$.text') LIKE 'memory injected%') AS injected FROM events WHERE kind='log' AND json_extract(payload,'$.text') LIKE 'memory %' GROUP BY run) m ON m.run=r.run ORDER BY 1
